observed_compatibility_changes: A maintained CPython-derived tomllib port now compiles tomllib.loads() into native programs through the dynamic-Any library boundary.
The selected API program covers all documented TOML scalar/container/date-time result kinds and typed narrowing from dynamic values.
The selected upstream-derived corpus covers 62 CPython TOML data documents, including 50 exact error-message cases.
TOMLDecodeError keeps the tomllib module name in the selected uncaught-exception recording.
adaptations_and_limits: The port uses dict[Any, Any] and an explicit empty-table helper where CPython writes untyped empty dicts (#777).
Flags uses dict keys instead of sets, and pending flags use a list because runtime-length tuple elements in sets remain unsupported (#775/#783).
One parser local is explicitly Callable because functions as local union values remain bounded (#782).
Regex group values are asserted or converted from str | None where the pattern guarantees they matched (#783).
tomllib.load(fp) remains unsupported because binary files are unavailable (#493); read text and call loads().
Dynamic-Any deviations remain: concrete annotation mismatch raises TypeError, and keys()/values()/items() produce lists.
parse_float returning a typed dict/list is a compile-time error; an Any dict/list result raises CPython's ValueError.
